scope: Selected DeepSeek harness guidance and evaluation surfaces: repository instructions, license and safety documents; CI-test reliability and archived-agent-note skills with their supporting docs/scripts/tests; session-snapshot evaluation design and linked replay/smoke support; experimental auto-review risk notes. limits: The pinned recursive Git tree is complete (25,329 entries, not truncated), but only the listed files received deep inspection and exact-byte SHA-256 hashing.
Source content was read only through GitHub commit/tree/blob APIs; no checkout, execution, installation, or enabling was performed.
The snapshot package implementation, replay internals, hook adapters, MCP/context/compaction and most runtime dependencies remain indexed-only; external links were not followed.
Auto-review was inspected as a risk-bearing experiment, not evaluated as an enabled permission control; it is not recommended for direct adoption.
next: Inspect the remaining 18 skill entrypoints and their linked local support, then deepen relevant prompts, tool/MCP manifests, and repository hooks.
Trace agent-loop/tool dispatch, context and compaction assembly, persistence, hook adapters, and runtime permission boundaries through implementations and tests.
Deep-inspect the session-snapshot suite/runner, fixtures, LLM replay implementation, loader smoke implementation, and their local transitive runtime dependencies.
Review third-party notices and target-runtime/license compatibility before curating any code; keep auto-review reference-only unless a separate security review approves a concrete design.
